comment: The four paths are at PathGenerator.cpp:44-99. The spiral turns when its coordinate crosses the resolution minus the other coordinate, which makes a square spiral rather than a round one. The random setting compares a fresh uniform number against the speed knob each sample, so at a speed of 1 it picks a new pixel every sample. The output voltage is ten times the position over the resolution, with five taken off in the bipolar setting (lines 101-105), so the head never quite reaches the top of the range.
